params.1266: Shellfish Roasting On An Open Fire
params.1273: Cook a crayfish so that it's edible.
params.1274: You can fish some crayfish at the lake.
params.1275: <col=FFFFFF>Right-click</col> a crayfish in your inventory and select <col=FFFFFF>use</col>. Then click on a <col=FFFFFF>cooking fire</col> or <col=FFFFFF>range</col> to cook it.
params.1276: Sometimes when cooking, you will burn the food. Make sure you bring plenty. You can catch more crayfish at a fishing spot.
params.2225:
Cooking food gives Cooking XP and makes food you can eat to heal. Burned food doesn't give XP and can't be eaten. Most players just drop it on the floor.

Most raw meat and fish and some more unusual things can be cooked.
